name: Special Meeting Memo
agenda_text:
The City of San Diego
Office of Council President Joe LaCava
First District
M e m o r a n d u m
date: September 14, 2026
to: Honorable City Councilmembers
from: Council President Joe LaCava, District 1
subject: Special City Council Meeting and Adjournment of Regular Meeting
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________
The regularly scheduled City Council Meeting on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, is adjourned. In its stead, the City Council will convene for a Special Meeting on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, during the following times.
The Council will convene at 10:00am in Open Session to hear the following items:
Public Comment on Special Closed Session items
The Council will then recess into Closed Session and reconvene at 2:00 p.m. to hear the following:
Consent agenda items: Updates to Council Policy 300-04, “Annual Salary Review of Positions with Salaries Established by Council
Appointment to the Board of Library Commissioners
Appointment to the Community Forest Advisory Board
Discussion agenda items: Informational item regarding the Fiscal Year 2026 Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report (CAPER) for U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) Programs
Updates to Council Policy 000-10 “Council Meeting Rooms, Display Area, and Facility Use Policy”
Report out from Closed Session
Non-agenda public comment
The City Council will resume its regular order of business on Monday, September 28, 2026, at 10:00AM at the City Administration Building, in City Council Chambers on the 12 th floor of 202 “C” Street.
If you have questions, please contact Luz Anaya Luna, Director of Legislative Affairs, at (619) 235-5880 or lanayaluna@sandiego.gov and Heidi Palmer, Legislative Analyst, at (619) 533-3920 or palmerh@sandiego.gov .
cc: Honorable Mayor Todd Gloria
Honorable City Attorney Heather Ferbert
Charles Modica, Independent Budget Analyst
Diana Fuentes, City Clerk
